title: Finite family matrix index bijection
statement: Let $\mathcal F$ be a finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices, and let $m$ be a natural number. There is a bijection between pairs consisting of a member of $\mathcal F$ and an index in $\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and the indices in $\{0,\ldots,|\mathcal F|m-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite family of subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices
